title: Stir-Fried Bok Choy with Glazed Delight
description: A quick and easy Asian-inspired stir-fry made with tender bok choy and sweet glazed delight. Perfect for a weeknight dinner or lunch.

ingredients.name: Bok Choy
ingredients.notes: Separate the leaves from the stems

instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and ginger and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the bok choy and stir-fry until the leaves are wilted, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the glazed delight and stir-fry for another minute.
Season with soy sauce and honey to taste.
